testCase.name: ProGuard Rule Missing
testCase.description: Runtime crash in release build due to obfuscation

metadata.context: Gson reflection methods removed by R8

expectedFix.explanation: Add ProGuard keep rule for serialization classes

agent_response.rootCause: ProGuard removed the toJson method from com.example.** { *; } because it's used with reflection or in conjunction with Gson.
fixGuidelines: 1. Open app/proguard-rules.pro and add a new rule to keep all classes containing toJson.
